fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xayah''' leaps into the air, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and {{tip|untargetable}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. After 1 second, she shoots 5 {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} in a cone in the target direction that deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
fields.description2: '''''Xayah''' is unable to basic attack or cast abilities during Featherstorm, but can still move.''
